pages.title: Home
pages.about: What needs you this week and how your projects are doing, for your role.

pages.title: Today
pages.about: Each site's day: what came in, what is missing, what needs you.

pages.title: Daily reports
pages.about: Every DPR, newest first.

pages.title: Weekly & monthly
pages.about: A week or a month in one report: work against plan, labour, materials, money and what needs you, as PDF and Excel.

pages.title: Issues
pages.about: Hindrances reported from site, open until someone acts.

pages.title: Approvals
pages.about: Everything waiting on you in one place: requests, bills, wages, reports, counts, tasks.

pages.title: Site log
pages.about: Everything the sites sent: work, photos, all entries.

pages.title: Analytics
pages.about: Trends across days and sites.

pages.title: My tasks
pages.about: What is given to you, late first, then by the day it is due.

pages.title: All tasks
pages.about: Every open task on the projects you see, by person, site and due day.

pages.title: Overdue
pages.about: Tasks past their day and still not done, with who has them.

pages.title: Done
pages.about: What was finished and who closed it.

pages.title: Project start
pages.about: From "we won it" to "work starts": stage, contract dates, the BOQ from your Excel, the schedule, the site team, suppliers.
pages.setup: Guided project, chapter 2: Set up Green Villa

pages.title: Schedule
pages.about: The project timeline: what should happen when, what site has done, what is late and what it pushes.

pages.title: BOQ & budget
pages.about: Every work item with its quantity, client rate and budget rate.

pages.title: Material plan
pages.about: What each material is needed for, week by week, from the BOQ and the schedule, against stock and orders; red from the week it runs short.

pages.title: Live plans
pages.about: The drawings as live maps: every room and footing coloured by the work site sent on WhatsApp, per trade, with photos and a live feed.

pages.title: Places
pages.about: Every floor and room coloured by the work site reported there, with the photos of each room; "what's left on the first floor?" on WhatsApp.

pages.title: Drawing check
pages.about: Drop the architect's PDF: its sheets, levels, room sizes and fixtures, and what to ask the architect before it reaches site.

pages.title: Documents
pages.about: Drawings with their revision, permits with their expiry, the contract and estimate (office only), per project; "send me the latest S-101" on WhatsApp.

pages.title: Overview
pages.about: Every project with a BOQ, worst first: budget, done against spent, committed, the forecast at completion, the last 7 days.

pages.title: BOQ & budget
pages.about: Every work item with its quantity, client rate and budget rate, the work done on it and the budget it earned.

pages.title: Green / red
pages.about: Each BOQ line's labour against the labour budget its work earned, per day or period: green, amber or red, worst first, with why.

pages.title: Budget vs actual
pages.about: For a project: the budget, the budget earned by the work done, and the money spent, for labour, materials and subcontract; per BOQ line the labour put on it against the labour it earned.

pages.title: Materials vs BOQ
pages.about: Per material: what the work done needed by the BOQ norms against what was used, and what is short to finish beyond stock and open orders.

pages.title: Cost centres
pages.about: Where the money went: materials, labour, subcontract, fuel, equipment.

pages.title: Stock
pages.about: What is on site now, how long it lasts, what is coming on orders and what the sites asked for; a minimum per item, and a morning note with a draft request when a site goes below it.

pages.title: Movements
pages.about: The register: every delivery, use and move.

pages.title: Items
pages.about: Your list of materials, with category and unit.

pages.title: Requests
pages.about: What the site asks for, before anyone orders it.

pages.title: Stock count
pages.about: Count a site on a phone; book against counted, the differences in units and rupees; the owner approves them into the book. Sites not counted in 30 days are flagged.

pages.title: Stock value
pages.about: What the stock on site is worth (quantity x average rate), by category, the top items, and what has not moved in 30 days.

pages.title: Requests
pages.about: What the sites ask for, before anyone orders it.

pages.title: Purchase orders
pages.about: Orders to suppliers, with what is still to arrive and duplicate warnings.

pages.title: Pending deliveries
pages.about: What is ordered but has not arrived, by date or by supplier, with one message to chase each shop.

pages.title: Rates
pages.about: What each item cost, from which supplier, over time.

pages.title: Quotations
pages.about: Ask several suppliers, compare side by side as each really costs you (GST and all), and order the chosen ones.

pages.title: Suppliers
pages.about: Suppliers with phone, GSTIN and credit days, and what you owe each one.

pages.title: Returns
pages.about: Material sent back to the supplier from a GRN, a delivery or their page; the debit note lowers what you owe them at once, until a replacement or credit settles it.

pages.title: Attendance
pages.about: Who worked today, by contractor and trade.

pages.title: Muster roll
pages.about: A site's month as the grid sites keep: each person down, each day across, P / ½ / A, overtime, totals; from attendance, never typed again. Export for the contractor or the labour office.

pages.title: Workers
pages.about: Your workers and their daily wage.

pages.title: Teams
pages.about: Labour contractors and their teams: who is in each, how many days they did; a team is paid through its contractor and has its own account.

pages.title: Wages
pages.about: A site's pay week: each worker and team, days from attendance × wage, overtime, the advance taken back and deductions, to pay; approve, pay from cash or bank, send the slip.

pages.title: Advances
pages.about: Money given to a worker or a labour team before payday, from a money account; taken back off their next wages on its own.

pages.title: Subcontractors
pages.about: Every outside team, what they work on, and what you owe each.

pages.title: Work orders
pages.about: Who does which work at what rate.

pages.title: Bills & checks
pages.about: Each payment checked against the quantity measured.

pages.title: Expenses
pages.about: Every expense with its photo and who paid.

pages.title: Money
pages.about: Accounts and petty cash balances.

pages.title: Suppliers
pages.about: Suppliers, subcontractors, hire and services, and what you owe each: bills, deliveries not billed, payments, advances, balance.

pages.title: Settings
pages.about: Categories and finance options.

pages.title: Project P&L
pages.about: Profit or loss of each project: billed to the client minus every cost booked to it, its position (received, owed, retention held), against the BOQ budget.

pages.title: Ledgers
pages.about: Every ledger in the books with its balance: suppliers, clients, bank and cash, expense heads; each with every entry and a running balance.

pages.title: Receivables
pages.about: What each client owes, most first, by age; money received against a bill, on account or as an advance.

pages.title: Cash & bank book
pages.about: Every cash box and bank account: opening, money in, money out, closing, day by day.

pages.title: Day book
pages.about: Every voucher of a period, day by day: purchases, payments, receipts, sales, contra and journals, posted from the records on their own.

pages.title: Tally export
pages.about: A period's expenses and payments as Tally vouchers, with their ledgers, for the accountant to import. One way.

pages.title: GST
pages.about: Output GST on RA bills and input GST you can claim, net payable in GSTR-3B terms, IGST or CGST + SGST by state; every bill with its GSTIN; credit missed and why.

pages.title: TDS
pages.about: TDS deducted from subcontractors (194C), deposited or due by the 7th; TDS clients deducted from your RA bills, to claim.

pages.title: Cash flow
pages.about: Money coming in and going out each week from today: client bills owed, supplier and subcontractor bills, deliveries not billed, open orders and wages, and the cash it leaves.

pages.title: Profit & loss
pages.about: The company's (or a project's, or a site's) income and costs for a period: gross and net profit, against the period before or last year.

pages.title: Balance sheet
pages.about: What the company owns and owes on a date, with the year's profit in capital.

pages.title: Trial balance
pages.about: Every ledger balance in its group, debits equal to credits, for the company, a project or a site; checked against Money, suppliers and Receivables.

pages.title: Chart of accounts
pages.about: The ledgers and groups the books use, in Tally's groups; a ledger per supplier, client, account and category made on its own.

pages.title: Months
pages.about: Each month open or closed; a change after close is posted on the first open day and marked.

pages.title: Clients
pages.about: Each client, their projects and contract values; the terms each RA bill uses.

pages.title: RA bills
pages.about: Running bills from the work site measured since the last bill × the client rates, with retention, advance recovery, GST and TDS worked out; printed on your letterhead.

pages.title: Variations
pages.about: Extra or changed work the client asked for: priced, sent, approved, then on the BOQ so it is measured and billed like any line.

pages.title: Client view
pages.about: A link the house owner opens on the phone, no login: progress, milestones, photos from approved site reports, bills and payments. Never rates or costs.

pages.title: Machines
pages.about: Every machine on every site: hours worked, idle and broken down, diesel, hire cost, service due.

pages.title: Daily log
pages.about: One day, every machine: the evening's figures in one screen.

pages.title: Hire check
pages.about: The hire bill against the hours recorded on site.

pages.title: Vehicles
pages.about: Company vehicles: trips, fuel and who drove.

pages.title: Shuttering & tools
pages.about: Which site holds how many plates, props and tools.

pages.title: Settings
pages.about: Everything you set up once: company, projects and sites, team, WhatsApp, modules.

pages.title: Projects & sites
pages.about: Each project, its sites and who gets its reports.

pages.title: Team
pages.about: Everyone who reports to or reads from Mesiri, with their role and sites.

pages.title: Company
pages.about: Company details, letterhead, logo and report settings.

pages.title: WhatsApp
pages.about: Conversations with Mesiri, every message, and scheduled messages.

pages.title: Bring your data
pages.about: Everything you already have, brought into Mesiri in one place: sites, team, materials and vendors, the BOQ, drawings. Each shows whether it is in yet.

pages.title: Activity log
pages.about: Who changed what, when: every save, edit, delete and approval, on the web and on WhatsApp, newest first. Read only.
